name: wechat-social-assistant
description: Local-first WeChat relationship memory assistant (macOS): captures only what is visible in the WeChat window via system OCR, stores everything in a local SQLite database (0600/0700 permissions), and surfaces contact briefs, follow-up suggestions, and weekly relationship reports over 32 MCP tools. Pinned to the immutable PyPI release wechat-social-assistant==1.5.1 over uvx stdio. It never reads WeChat's databases, never injects into WeChat, and never sends messages.
